Russia as it is now, is of a different kind. The Russia that existed during the Soviet Union era was a better Russia, considering the way Marxist ideology was embraced, and after Lenin, the various Soviets that were established there, the prevailing tendencies, the socialist ideology and the socialist system itself, they were all superior. Now capitalism has become dominant in it,
The current situation with Russia is very bad. War should not happen Every single thing can be resolved through peaceful dialog
